# Ribbon Protocol, ribbon 2

This file is the whole protocol in one file, rendered from the pieces under `protocol/`. A full
install renders its own block into the project's `AGENTS.md` and each seat's files under
`.ribbon/protocol/`, and a standalone install into `AGENTS.local.md` and its instance. The
long-form guide is `docs/field-guide.md`, the PDF as text; the schemas and the templates live
under `docs/`. The optional Herdr overlay is `protocol/handlers/herdr_template.md`, which an
install writes as the architect's seat file. An architect inside Herdr reads it before any Herdr
execution; its rules govern orchestration only.
